description: For vendor setup, this checklist records business need, sourcing decision, contract status, payment terms, insurance, security access, and risk classification. Its supporting evidence includes tax form, bank verification, insurance certificate, screening results, contract, approval, and system-entry evidence.

title: Vendor Setup Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during vendor due diligence and system setup when the vendor setup record must identify vendor legal name, tax and banking data, ownership, contacts, goods or services, locations, and related-party status. Complete the applicable handoff for approved vendor ID, controls applied, payment method, renewal dates, document retention, and requester notification.
